bibl.title: Concepts of Egypt in Augustan Rome: Two Case Studies of Cameo Glass from the British Museum.
bibl.seg: M.E.J.J. van Aerde, Concepts of Egypt in Augustan Rome: Two Case Studies of Cameo Glass from the British Museum.
British Museum Studies in Ancient Egypt and Sudan 20 (2013) pp. 1-23, 10 figg. n./bl. et coul.
bibl.note: Cameo glass. - Case study 1: Glass Isis (British Museum, Inv. EA 16600). - Case study 2: Exiled obelisk? (British Museum, Inv. G&R 1982,0404.1). - Conclusion. - Research on the visual language of Augustan Rome is mainly focused on Greek influences, but Egypt likewise played an important role in Augustus' propaganda programme. - Avec résumé en anglais.
